title: Daily Transaction Volume
scenario: Find the average daily 'amount' of transactions for each 'country'. Return the result table as 'country' and 'avg_daily_amount'.
tableSchema: transactions (id INT, country VARCHAR, state VARCHAR, amount INT, trans_date DATE)
hint: First aggregate by country and trans_date, then take the average of that result.
correctQuery: SELECT country, AVG(daily_sum) AS avg_daily_amount FROM (SELECT country, trans_date, SUM(amount) AS daily_sum FROM transactions GROUP BY country, trans_date) t GROUP BY country;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE transactions (id INT, country VARCHAR, state VARCHAR, amount INT, trans_date DATE); INSERT INTO transactions VALUES (1, 'US', 'approved', 100, '2019-01-01'), (2, 'US', 'approved', 200, '2019-01-01');
